cost_dimensions.external: At most two public source reads, zero paid/provider calls, zero upstream writes.
cost_dimensions.failure_risk: Primary risks are outcome contamination, stale or inconsistent package metadata, unofficial commands, silent reselection, and overclaiming a baseline as behavioral evidence.
cost_dimensions.latency: One bounded metadata and baseline-command gate; no downstream arm execution.
cost_dimensions.quality: Prefer exact pre-outcome provenance and a truthful NOT_EVALUABLE result over a convenient or outcome-selected source.
cost_dimensions.token: Use compact exact manifests and source hashes; do not duplicate historical payloads.
cost_dimensions.tool: Read-only public-source and installed-distribution inspection plus one official baseline command for at most one selected source.

evidence_to_collect: An immutable pre-outcome protocol binding no more than two public Candidate sources, deterministic order, eligibility predicates, exact repository and distribution versions, environment identity, budgets, official baseline command, and stopping rules.

For at most one selected source, installed distribution metadata and the exact output and exit status of one official unmodified baseline test command; otherwise a NOT_EVALUABLE ledger for every Candidate and failed predicate.
A contamination and non-reuse audit proving selection used no observed task outcome and none of the closed Click, Twisted, ARC, forecasting, planning, or author-release trials was replayed.
result.reason: The exact upcoming unit is a zero-arm source and installed-distribution baseline entry gate. None of the indexed Execute Candidates has deterministic verification for this scope, and the active-for-scope Candidates are confined to different live-campaign scopes. Two indexed Candidate prompt/record paths are absent from the published repository and therefore cannot be trialed or applied. Use the active Execute prompt without an overlay, promotion, provider call, task-outcome inspection, or behavioral arm.
regression_checks: Keep prompts/execute.md, active-components, Candidate records, statuses, and scope states unchanged.
Start zero behavioral arms, construct zero no-fault controls, take zero semantic attempts, make zero provider or paid calls, and perform zero upstream writes.
Do not patch, solve, resample, hint, dispatch CI for a source project, or replace a failed source after observing a task outcome.
Select at most one source from at most two predeclared public Candidates and preserve every negative or missing result.
Treat a runnable baseline only as entry-gate evidence, never as recovery benefit, low harm rate, transfer, independence, user-level completion, or AGI.
Preserve all inherited continuations and all completed invocation replay prohibitions.
result.rollback: Keep the active Execute prompt and all Candidate state unchanged. If the gate is incomplete or any binding is missing, return NOT_EVALUABLE and continue through ordinary evaluation without selecting a convenient replacement or replaying a closed trial.
